definition: פִּתְגָּם noun masculine edict, decree (Persian loan-word, Old Persian patigâma ( patigam , come to, arrive ), New Persian paigâm , message ; see Gildem ZKM iv. 214 Mey Entstehung 23 ; Aramaic פִּתְגָּמָא , word, command , Biblical Aramaic = Biblical Hebrew); — construct הַטֶּלֶךְ ׳ פ Esth 1:20 with genitive object מַעֲשֵׂה הָרָעָה ׳ פ Eccl 8:11 (apparently f., compare De ; but Hi Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 115 read נַעֲשֶׂה for נַעֲשָׂה ).
